{"action":"final","query":{"op":"none","scope":null,"id":null,"text":null,"start":null,"end":null,"offset":null,"derived_op":null,"groupBy":null},"diagnosis":"Sparsemax computes its support and threshold from uncentered fp32 values. Large common offsets cause rounding in prefix sums, subtraction of the unit simplex mass, and output subtraction. Observed sparse-04 has 512/512 mismatches: outputs are 0.0078125 instead of 0.00390625; inputs remain unchanged. The bf16 offset cases also fail every output, while both zero-offset fp32 controls and the narrower fp16 control pass. Repair by subtracting the row maximum before support/threshold arithmetic and applying the same shift to output values. After centering, the threshold lies in [-1, 0], so clipping values below -1 preserves the projection and prevents extreme finite inputs from producing overflowing prefix sums. Masked lanes remain excluded. Input storage, output shape/dtype, and backward behavior are preserved. Compilation and post-patch correctness could not be verified through this API; the supplied observations describe the original implementation.","locations":[{"source_id":"source-34","start_line":31,"end_line":61}],"citations":[{"case_id":"sparse-00","evidence_ids":["observation-sparse-00"]},{"case_id":"sparse-01","evidence_ids":["observation-sparse-01"]},{"case_id":"sparse-02","evidence_ids":["observation-sparse-02"]},{"case_id":"sparse-03","evidence_ids":["observation-sparse-03"]},{"case_id":"sparse-04","evidence_ids":["observation-sparse-04"]},{"case_id":"sparse-05","evidence_ids":["observation-sparse-05"]}],"edits":[{"source_id":"source-34","old":"    z_valid = tl.where(mask, z_sorted_block, 0.0)
    cssv = tl.cumsum(z_valid, 0)","new":"    # Sparsemax is invariant to a common row offset. Center before
    # subtracting the unit simplex mass to avoid cancellation.
    row_max = tl.max(z_sorted_block, 0)
    # The centered threshold is in [-1, 0]; entries below -1 have
    # zero mass. Clipping also bounds prefix sums for extreme inputs.
    z_sorted_block = tl.where(mask, tl.maximum(z_sorted_block - row_max, -1.0), -float("inf"))
    z_valid = tl.where(mask, z_sorted_block, 0.0)
    cssv = tl.cumsum(z_valid, 0)"},{"source_id":"source-34","old":"    y = tl.maximum(x_block - tau, 0.0)","new":"    x_centered = tl.maximum(x_block - row_max, -1.0)
    y = tl.maximum(x_centered - tau, 0.0)"}]}
